title: Junior Hardware Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Support our hardware team with circuits and enclosure design.

What you'll do
- Design simple circuits and PCB layouts with KiCad

- Support certification tests

What you bring
- 3+ years of experience, or 1 year of experience plus a bachelor's degree in engineering

- Good English
